title: Hybrid retrieval in Qdrant (dense MiniLM, French BM25, RRF fusion)
platform: Windows 11, Python 3.12 environment managed by uv, Qdrant local mode (folder .qdrant)
environment: VIGIE_QDRANT_PATH=.qdrant VIGIE_EMBEDDING_CACHE_DIR=data/cache/models PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 PYTHONPATH=src; vigie-ingest, vigie-index and vigie-eval run through their main() functions because the console scripts of the shared virtual environment point at another checkout

runs.note: The fresh worktree had no Cellar cache, so a first run at 08:03 UTC downloaded the four texts from Cellar over HTTPS, one request per second at most (cache files written 2 s apart), and checked them against data/corpus.lock. This file is the rerun just before indexing, read from that cache, same sha256 and article counts.
First build: 511 chunks embedded, 511 points, models downloaded once into data/cache/models.
Idempotence: same collection name, nothing embedded, still 511 points.

Top-5 for three questions with RRF k = 60. Q1 brings DORA art. 28 at ranks 2 and 4, under DORA art. 31 (designation of critical ICT third-party providers); Q2 brings AIACT art. 5 first; Q3 brings RGPD art. 33 first. Excerpts are cut at 90 characters; the trailing spaces this leaves were trimmed by the trailing-whitespace pre-commit hook, nothing else changed.
47 dev questions that expect an article, top 20 passages per question, metrics on distinct articles. The sealed test split was not read.
Same measure at commit e845691dc7b8e011bd0a3d8618084d91157820e9, before the RRF constant setting: plain FusionQuery(fusion=RRF), constant fixed at 2.
Dev-split diagnostics: each branch alone, prefetch depth sweep, RRF constant and weight variants.

iterations.decision: no effect on recall, default kept at 20

iterations.change: RRF constant 60 instead of the fixed constant 2 of FusionQuery
finer chunks, VIGIE_CORPUS_SPLIT_WORDS=200 (1688 chunks instead of 511), separate corpus and collection under data/cache
iterations.raw_output: dense only recall@5=0.5319 mrr=0.4016; bm25 only recall@5=0.3191 mrr=0.2468; hybrid rrf prefetch=20 recall@5=0.4894 mrr=0.4280

results.check: python tasks.py check green after merging main: 520 passed, coverage 99 % on src, 100 % on src/vigie/retrieval

observations: Qdrant fuses RRF with 1/(k + position), positions from 0; the plain FusionQuery uses k = 2, so a passage first in both lists scores 1.0 and a single list can dominate.
BM25 alone is weak (recall@5 0.36): 30 % of the golden questions are in English while the BM25 branch stems French.
Chunks of up to 1200 words exceed the 512 tokens the dense model reads, so the dense vector only sees the start of long articles.
